commentary_title: Expansion in utilisation of Handysize vessels
commentary_summary: The utilisation of Handyszie vessels expanded last week to reach 93.2% from 92.6% the week before. | Meanwhile, the tonnemile index continued to be on a downward trend, declining for the second consecutive week. | The laden tonnage at anchor in China was buoyant as Russia continued to ship coal from its ports in the Far East to China. | China's coal inventory has been high MoM but lower YoY. With buoyant demand for electricity, the trade on this route is projected to be significant in the near-term.
